caveats: Batch was built from Yahoo Local directory pages; three entries are permanently closed (J&J, Vic's, Oasis) and two more could not be verified (Mustang Man, East Brunswick Appliance Repair), so the usable prospect pool is small.
Google Maps review counts were read from a desktop browser session; where the count was not rendered ('count not displayed') only the rating was recorded.
Rayco's aggregator description mentions 'online appointment requests', but no such form exists on the current site - treated as a possibly lost feature, not a current capability.

Nice Guys Appliances is a two-store New Jersey independent; it was kept rather than marked a chain because it is not a franchise, but its scores are the least certain because its site could not be reviewed.
data_gaps: Nice Guys Appliances: niceguysappliance.com returned HTTP 429 / PerimeterX 'Access denied' on every attempt, so the customer-view website review, booking flow and phone-width layout could not be assessed. No form was submitted.
Mustang Man Repair: no Google Maps listing for the name or for phone (908) 801-6678; only a syndicated Yahoo/Yelp record. Existence unconfirmed.

East Brunswick Appliance Repair: no Google profile and no website; phone (732) 659-3015 has no map match. The similarly named eastbrunswickappliancerepairs.com uses a different number and was not assumed to be the same business.
Review counts were not visible on the Google listings for Apex Appliance and Nice Guys Appliances; only star ratings were shown.
Employee counts are not published for any of these businesses; size signals are review volume, locations and named staff only.
Oasis Towing: Google says permanently closed and its website domain is dead, but one directory still describes it as active - status rests on Google's label.
Phone-width layout was only captured for Rayco and Apex, the only two reachable sites in this batch; the rest have no website.
